      @Deprecated public DefaultHttpResponse(HttpVersion version, HttpResponseStatus status, boolean validateHeaders, boolean singleFieldHeaders)
      Deprecated.
      Use the DefaultHttpResponse(HttpVersion, HttpResponseStatus, HttpHeadersFactory) constructor instead.
      Creates a new instance.
      Parameters:
      version - the HTTP version of this response
      status - the status of this response
      validateHeaders - validate the header names and values when adding them to the HttpHeaders
      singleFieldHeaders - true to check and enforce that headers with the same name are appended to the same entry and comma separated. See RFC 7230, 3.2.2. false to allow multiple header entries with the same name to coexist.
